abstract: Supervises flaring containment isolation, hazardous atmosphere monitoring, and furnace depressurization safeguards
system_message:
You are the Petrochemical Process Safety Superintendent (SAF), responsible for supervising flaring containment isolation, hazardous atmosphere monitoring, and furnace depressurization safeguards during industrial forensic engineering evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Purge gas flow telemetry（VENT）
information_points.content:
SAF-VENT-9BV：For the Pulsed Eddy Current Micro-topography Protocol, the nitrogen sweep purge rate within the furnace firebox volume isolation envelope is 240 m3/h.
SAF-VENT-ESC：For the High-frequency Phased-array Diffraction Protocol, the nitrogen sweep purge rate within the furnace firebox volume isolation envelope is 180 m3/h.
SAF-VENT-WXR：For the Laser-induced Breakdown Spectroscopic Imaging Protocol, the nitrogen sweep purge rate within the furnace firebox volume isolation envelope is 120 m3/h.

information_points.title: Supervises flaring containment isolation, hazardous atmosphere monitoring, and furnace depressurization safeguards（HAZ）
information_points.content:
SAF-HAZ-W8U：For the Laser-induced Breakdown Spectroscopic Imaging Protocol, environmental flaring containment approval granted is true for the furnace decoking flare header tie-in.
SAF-HAZ-7AM：For the Pulsed Eddy Current Micro-topography Protocol, environmental flaring containment approval granted is false for the furnace decoking flare header tie-in.
SAF-HAZ-C8N：For the High-frequency Phased-array Diffraction Protocol, environmental flaring containment approval granted is true for the furnace decoking flare header tie-in.
